modelOverview: Launched in 2007, the Ballon Bleu de Cartier reimagined the Maison's watchmaking with a rounded, balloon-like case and a signature protected crown set with a blue synthetic spinel. The 42mm size is the flagship men's proportion of the line, offered on both steel bracelets and leather straps with automatic Cartier movements.

W69012Z4.materials: Stainless steel case and stainless steel bracelet with deployant clasp
W69012Z4.dial: Silver dial with bold Roman numerals, blued sword-shaped hands, date aperture at 3 o'clock
W69012Z4.description: The W69012Z4 is the quintessential steel-on-steel Ballon Bleu 42mm, pairing a silver Roman-numeral dial with a stainless steel bracelet. Its rounded case, sapphire cabochon crown and blued hands make it instantly recognisable as a Cartier icon. Every piece we offer is sourced and authenticated prior to sale.

WSBB0026.movement: Automatic · Cartier Calibre 1847 MC · ~42h power reserve · 28,800 vph · 23 jewels
WSBB0026.materials: Stainless steel case; black alligator leather strap with steel interchangeable deployant buckle
WSBB0026.dial: Silver guilloché opaline dial with Roman numerals, blued sword-shaped hands, date aperture at 3 o'clock
WSBB0026.description: The WSBB0026 is a steel-cased Ballon Bleu 42mm fitted on a black alligator leather strap rather than the metal bracelet, giving a dressier profile around the same silver guilloché dial and cabochon-set crown. It runs on Cartier's in-house Calibre 1847 MC automatic movement. Every piece we offer is sourced and authenticated prior to sale.
